name: Python
description: Python is great for scripting, backend work, automation, and data processing. This track covers practical fundamentals and a mini CLI project.

snippets.title: Create Virtual Environment and Install Tools
snippets.codeDes: Isolate dependencies for each project and keep setup reproducible.
snippets.code:
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install --upgrade pip
pip install pytest

snippets.title: Project Structure for Python CLI Learning
snippets.codeDes: Separate application modules, data, and tests from the start.
snippets.code:
habit-tracker/
  app/
    __init__.py
    models.py
    storage.py
    cli.py
  data/
    habits.json
  tests/
    test_storage.py
  requirements.txt

snippets.title: Model Data with dataclass (app/models.py)
snippets.codeDes: dataclass gives readable domain objects without boilerplate.
snippets.code:
from dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass
class Habit:
    id: str
    name: str
    streak: int = 0
    completed_today: bool = False

snippets.title: JSON Storage Helpers (app/storage.py)
snippets.codeDes: Keep file operations in one module for easier testing.

snippets.title: CLI with argparse (app/cli.py)
snippets.codeDes: Use subcommands to grow from one script into a maintainable CLI.
snippets.code:
import argparse

def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="habit")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    add_cmd = sub.add_parser("add")
    add_cmd.add_argument("name")

    sub.add_parser("list")
    return parser

snippets.title: CLI Command Dispatch (app/cli.py)
snippets.codeDes: Parse arguments once, then delegate to focused command functions.

snippets.title: Mini Project: Add Habit Command
snippets.codeDes: Command handlers should validate input and persist changes.
snippets.code:
from uuid import uuid4
from app.storage import read_habits, save_habits

def add_habit(name: str) -> None:
    habits = read_habits()
    habits.append({
        "id": str(uuid4()),
        "name": name,
        "streak": 0,
        "completed_today": False,
    })
    save_habits(habits)

snippets.title: Mini Project: Mark Habit Complete
snippets.codeDes: Update one record safely and keep command behavior deterministic.

snippets.title: Automated Test Example (tests/test_storage.py)
snippets.codeDes: Test critical persistence behavior before adding more commands.
snippets.code:
from app.storage import save_habits, read_habits

def test_round_trip(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from app import storage
    monkeypatch.setattr(storage, "DATA_FILE", tmp_path / "habits.json")

    expected = [{"id": "1", "name": "Read", "streak": 2, "completed_today": False}]
    save_habits(expected)
    assert read_habits() == expected
